_comment: HUMAN-CURATED ERC-4337 EntryPoint allowlist for Base (chain 8453). An entry here lets a transaction's UserOperationEvent re-anchor the receipt on the smart account named by `sender`, so a wrong address would let any contract mint a beneficiary by replaying topic0 (0x49628fd1471006c1482da88028e9ce4dbb080b815c9b0344d39e5a8e6ec1419f) — the same rule applied to reactors.json and the aggregator router allowlists. Every address below was verified on Base directly: bytecode present AND actively emitting that topic0 (v0.6 / v0.7 / v0.8 observed at 5516 / 6733 / 348 events across a ~900-block window at head 49585778). The UserOperationEvent ABI is identical across v0.6 and v0.7, so one topic0 covers all entries. Do not append an address without repeating that on-chain verification.
